text: Mubadala Investment Company is First Abu Dhabi Bank's largest shareholder, with 37.9% of its shares as of 30 June 2026; FAB's notes describe Mubadala as one of the wholly owned strategic investment companies of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
short: Mubadala (wholly owned by the Emirate of Abu Dhabi) is FAB's largest shareholder at 37.9%

source.name: First Abu Dhabi Bank: Share Profile, ownership information (updated as of 30 June 2026)
source.note: Ownership table. The '1' after '(MIC)' is the page's footnote marker; the footnote reads: 'MIC is one of the wholly owned strategic investment companies of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi'.
